limitations: The report records proof-only performance honestly; it does not claim the P0/P1/P2 thresholds.
F01 is a repeated one-token workload for more than 30 minutes; F00 and P01 provide the separate correctness and short stable-generation evidence.
Stock Android denied zram and PSI reads; raw denial output is linked and not converted into a false zero.
notes: No runtime/model implementation files were changed by F02.
The report preserves negative optimization results and identifies CPU expert compute as the measured dominant bottleneck.
